report.question: 弱流如何延拓穿过奇点，放大模型何时具有重数一、凸性与分类，局部模型又怎样决定唯一性？
report.reading_scope: Read the complete mathematical text of arXiv:2510.01355v1 sections 1–5, PDF pp.1–18, and its references pp.19–22. Checked official SIAM title, author, DOI, pp.160–178, publication date, license, sections 1–2 and selected statements in sections 4–5. Supplemental primary reading was restricted to the exact definition/theorem passages recorded in actual_reading, not full proofs of every cited research result.

proof_scope.2M01: Definition with outward normal, unaveraged trace, and explicit distinction from convexity.
proof_scope.2M02: Full first-contact barrier proof after citing the curvature evolution identity from section 2.1; the evolution identity itself is not rederived.
proof_scope.2M03: Definition; sphere constant and dilation invariance calculated directly.
proof_scope.2M04: Both ball-center expansions and the connected-ball side argument are proved.
proof_scope.2M05: Andrews preservation theorem cited, with the role of the two-point maximum principle explained, not proved.
proof_scope.2M06: Time-interval expansion and invariance under parabolic scaling are calculated; convergence is not inferred from scaling alone.
proof_scope.2M07: Pointwise nonnegative principal curvature is deduced from HK Theorem 1.10. Global convexity and improvement to constant 1 remain cited results. Uses full-space smooth closed-domain Andrews flows, not arbitrary complete immersed flows.
proof_scope.2M08: Weak set-flow definition includes closed spacetime track and all compact smooth test flows.
proof_scope.2M09: Maximality gives uniqueness; similarity covariance proved using a bijection of competitors. Existence, semigroup, containment and smooth consistency are cited.
proof_scope.2M0A: Spacetime-boundary definition; positive-time ambient relative boundary and initial slice distinguished.
proof_scope.2M0B: Fattening and discrepancy defined; equality of first times and conical examples cited for closed embedded surfaces in R3.
proof_scope.2M0C: Integer rectifiable measure and associated varifold defined; tangent-plane representation uses rectifiability theory.
proof_scope.2M0D: Integral-in-time Brakke inequality with local area and square-integrable generalized curvature assumptions.
proof_scope.2M0E: Weighted transport identity proved from the existing area-density variation and the chain rule.
proof_scope.2M0F: Sudden disappearance of a plane verified directly in the time-integrated inequality.
proof_scope.2M0G: Density and two-sided unit regularity defined; existence of density uses the cited weak monotonicity theory.
proof_scope.2M0H: Mod-2 cyclicity defined using separate flat-chain note; odd triple junction example explained.
proof_scope.2M0I: Measure scaling and fixed/moving center distinction explicit. Compactness, Brakke realization and passage to equality in weak monotonicity remain external inputs.
proof_scope.2M0J: Multiplicity-one theorem cited only for appropriate outer/inner flows from closed embedded surfaces in R3; arbitrary Brakke counterexample included.
proof_scope.2M0K: Multiplicity-one cylindrical tangent-flow uniqueness, including axis uniqueness, cited; no assertion for arbitrary tangents.
proof_scope.2M0L: Ancient asymptotically (n,k)-cylindrical definition; k=0 allowed, and cyclicity separately required for the older R3 classification.
proof_scope.2M0M: Translator graph equation, radial ODE and tip second derivative calculated. Entire bowl existence/uniqueness cited.
proof_scope.2M0N: Standard 2-dimensional ancient oval defined by cited existence/uniqueness; asymptotic descriptions cited.
proof_scope.2M0O: CHH classification cited specifically for n=2,k=1 with unit regularity and cyclicity; proof outline only, no nonlinear estimates claimed.
proof_scope.2M0P: Mean-convex neighborhood and localized nonfattening cited. Local comparison is relative to the small spatial ball, not global nesting.
proof_scope.2M0Q: Deduction of nonfattening for embedded 2-spheres using cited multiplicity one, genus control, shrinker classification, regularity and mean-convex neighborhoods.
proof_scope.2M0R: Exact arbitrarily-small-C-infinity-graph perturbation statement checked against primary Theorem 1.1 and Remark 1; no proof of density drop reproduced.
proof_scope.2M0S: Complete report Theorem 4.1 model list with noncollapsing hypothesis; model families identified by their original constructions rather than symmetry alone.
proof_scope.2M0T: All four positive and three zero modes computed explicitly; full spectral exclusion uses cited Hermite-Fourier completeness, and the nonlinear classification remains external.
proof_scope.2M0U: Report normal form and fast/slow/mixed classification cited; ranks of displayed quadratic forms explained, not a proof of quantization.
proof_scope.2M0V: Canonical-neighborhood contradiction argument written after citing mean-convex compactness/noncollapsing and ancient classification.
proof_scope.2M0W: Report Problem 5.1 and conditional implications to tangent uniqueness/diameter recorded; not presented as solved.
proof_scope.2M0X: Parabolic Hausdorff dimension bound cited; time-direction dimension calculation given. Isolation/shrinking-tube questions distinguished from the bound.
proof_scope.2M0Y: Report formulations of high-dimensional multiplicity-one and genericity conjectures, distinguished from the later local cylindrical theorem.
proof_scope.2M0Z: Bamler-Lai v1 Theorem 1.11 cited with unit regularity, multiplicity-one (n,k)-cylinder, arrival-time formula and k-prime bound. Supplemental proof not reproduced.
proof_scope.2M10: Fixed-flow realization problem distinguished from varying initial data; cited ancient-oval/spherical-accumulation criterion, not its proof.
proof_scope.2M11: Conical selection problem and proposed vanishing-noise idea, without claiming a selection theorem.
proof_scope.2M12: Polyhedral flat-chain definition and continuity of boundary proved; norm nondegeneracy and rectifiable representation cited as GMT inputs.
proof_scope.2M13: Generalized mean curvature defined by absolutely continuous first variation; no singular boundary term silently discarded.
proof_scope.2M14: Translator equation equivalent to translated smooth flow by direct normal-velocity computation.

remaining_branches: The report's epsilon-regularity theorem, general Brakke compactness, elliptic regularization and noncompact weak Huisken monotonicity are cited inputs, not reconstructed proofs.

Full proofs of Andrews noncollapsing, sharp inscribed-radius improvement, genus monotonicity, Brendle genus-zero shrinker classification, Bamler-Kleiner multiplicity one, CM tangent uniqueness and CHH classification remain external.

The six-paper R4 classification program, construction and parameterization of HIMW translators and Du-Haslhofer ovals, differential neck estimates, and Hermite-Fourier completeness are not reconstructed.
Report Problem 5.7 (a mean-curvature-flow proof of the Smale conjecture), Problem 5.9 (immersed flows), and Ricci-flow Conjectures 5.15–5.17 were read but not expanded into new branches.

Higher-dimensional full ancient classification and convexity questions 5.13–5.14 require contextual updates beyond the specifically checked Bamler-Lai statements; no exhaustive 2026 literature audit is claimed.
Only the selected Bamler-Lai definition and theorem sections were read; its 59-page proof and prequel are not claimed fully audited.

actual_reading.scope: Complete mathematical sections 1–5, PDF pp.1–18; references pp.19–22.
Official metadata/license; sections 1–2 and selected Theorem 4.1 and section 5.2 statements; compared numbering with v1.
Section 1.3–1.5, Definitions 1.1–1.6, Theorem 1.10; smooth full-space Andrews class and local convexity estimate. Author PDF also inspected. Corollary 2.15 and its smooth-case proof were also read.
Section 1 including Theorem 1.1 and Remark 1; density-drop strategy and exact graph perturbation quantifiers.
Section 1.1–1.2 through Theorems 1.2–1.4; section 1.3 Theorems 1.11–1.12 and Definitions 1.13–1.14, Theorem 1.15; opening of 1.4. No claim of full proof reading.

terminology.status: Targeted BananaSpace search returned no corresponding readable entries. Repository terminology retained; English names and bubble-sheet supplied where helpful. No claim of external terminology alignment.
terminology.normal_convention: Outward nu, H=div_M nu, vector mean curvature=-H nu, agreeing with 2E01/2E03 and 0U0G. The report uses inward normal with the same positive scalar for spheres.

source_errata.resolution: Report arXiv v1 is October 2025; Bamler-Lai v1 is December 31, 2025; official proceedings publication is July 13, 2026. Followup wording means after the report preprint, not after the congress or proceedings publication.
Converted inward-normal vector H=H nu to repository outward-normal vector H=-H nu. Two-sided two-point inequality is invariant after exchanging its upper and lower sides.

Used the usual integrated Brakke formulation and made local area/curvature integrability explicit instead of silently using a pointwise derivative at a mass-drop time. No claim that this is an error in the source.

source_errata.location: Theorem 3.7 vs generalized asymptotically cylindrical definition
source_errata.resolution: 2M0O and outline explicitly restrict to (n,k)=(2,1); k=0 in 2M0L includes spheres and cannot be included in the three-model neck classification.
Noncollapsing retained for ancient classification and mean-convex initial data retained for the blowup/canonical-neighborhood application. Not generalized to arbitrary R4 singularities.
Historical conjecture is accompanied by a separately sourced later preprint theorem. Only precisely read later statements are updated; no exhaustive current-status claim for all section 5 problems.
